## Summary
Implement the document parsing step that converts uploaded PPTX/PDF files into structured LectureSection nodes in Supabase and Neo4j, using Python sidecars for format-specific extraction.

## User story
As a faculty member, I want my uploaded lecture (PPTX or PDF) to be automatically parsed into structured sections, so that downstream pipeline steps can process the content for knowledge graph ingestion.

## Why this matters
This is the entry point of the entire P1 pipeline. If parsing fails or produces poor-quality output, every downstream step (chunking, embedding, entity extraction, TEACHES edges) produces garbage. Incorrect slide ordering or missing content means SubConcepts will be incomplete or wrong, directly affecting student assessment quality.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] PPTX files parsed via python-pptx sidecar → slide text, images, speaker notes, slide order
- [ ] PDF files parsed via PyMuPDF sidecar → page text, images, page order
- [ ] LectureSection rows created in Supabase with: lecture_id, section_order, raw_text, has_images, has_speaker_notes
- [ ] LectureSection nodes created in Neo4j via neo4jQuery with: uuid, lecture_id, section_order
- [ ] Supabase written FIRST, Neo4j SECOND (Rule 6)
- [ ] Images extracted and stored in Supabase Storage (bucket: lecture-assets)
- [ ] Speaker notes extracted as raw text (stored temporarily for E03-S04)
- [ ] Pipeline status updated to 'parsed' in lectures table after completion
- [ ] Handles corrupt/empty files gracefully (sets status to 'parse_failed')

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Rule 1 (C05) | neo4jQuery for LectureSection node creation — wrapper injects institution_id |
| Rule 6 (G08) | Write LectureSection to Supabase FIRST, then create Neo4j node. Neo4j failure logged but never blocks |
| Rule 3 (AP-03) | If parsing multiple slides in parallel, use Promise.allSettled |

## API contract
```
Sidecar API (internal, localhost only):

POST http://localhost:8501/parse-pptx
Request: multipart/form-data { file: Binary }
Response: {
  slides: [{
    index: number,
    text: string,
    speaker_notes: string | null,
    images: [{ index: number, data: base64, mime: string }]
  }]
}

POST http://localhost:8502/parse-pdf
Request: multipart/form-data { file: Binary }
Response: {
  pages: [{
    index: number,
    text: string,
    images: [{ index: number, data: base64, mime: string }]
  }]
}
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// apps/inngest/functions/p1-steps/parse-scaffold.ts
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client'
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/server'

export async function parseDocument(
  lectureId: string,
  fileUrl: string,
  fileType: 'pptx' | 'pdf',
  institutionId: string
) {
  const supabase = createServerClient()

  // 1. Download file from Supabase Storage
  // 2. Send to appropriate sidecar
  // 3. Write LectureSection rows to Supabase FIRST (Rule 6)
  const { data: sections, error } = await supabase
    .from('lecture_sections')
    .insert(sectionRows)
    .select()

  if (error) throw error

  // 4. Create Neo4j nodes SECOND (Rule 6)
  await Promise.allSettled(
    sections.map(section =>
      neo4jQuery(institutionId, `
        MERGE (ls:LectureSection { uuid: $uuid })
        SET ls.lecture_id = $lectureId,
            ls.section_order = $sectionOrder
        WITH ls
        MATCH (l:Lecture { uuid: $lectureId })
        MERGE (l)-[:HAS_SECTION { section_order: $sectionOrder }]->(ls)
      `, { uuid: section.id, lectureId, sectionOrder: section.section_order })
    )
  )

  // 5. Update lecture status
  await supabase
    .from('lectures')
    .update({ pipeline_status: 'parsed' })
    .eq('id', lectureId)

  return sections
}
```

```typescript
import { driver } from 'neo4j-driver'

// ✗ AP-03: Promise.all for batch operations — use Promise.allSettled

// ✗ Rule 6 violation: Neo4j BEFORE Supabase

await supabase.from('lecture_sections').insert(...)  // WRONG ORDER
```

```typescript
// tests/E03/E03-S02.pipeline.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'
const INNGEST_BASE = process.env.INNGEST_DEV_URL || 'http://localhost:8288'

test.describe('E03-S02: Parse PPTX/PDF → LectureSection nodes', () => {
  test('PPTX sidecar returns structured slide data', async ({ request }) => {
    // Upload a test PPTX to the sidecar
    const res = await request.post('http://localhost:8501/parse-pptx', {
      multipart: {
        file: {
          name: 'test-lecture.pptx',
          mimeType: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation',
          buffer: Buffer.from('test'), // Replace with fixture file in CI
        },
      },
    })
    // Sidecar may not be running in all test envs — skip if unavailable
    if (res.ok()) {
      const data = await res.json()
      expect(data.slides).toBeDefined()
      expect(Array.isArray(data.slides)).toBe(true)
    }
  })

  test('PDF sidecar returns structured page data', async ({ request }) => {
    const res = await request.post('http://localhost:8502/parse-pdf', {
      multipart: {
        file: {
          name: 'test-lecture.pdf',
          mimeType: 'application/pdf',
          buffer: Buffer.from('test'), // Replace with fixture file in CI
        },
      },
    })
    if (res.ok()) {
      const data = await res.json()
      expect(data.pages).toBeDefined()
      expect(Array.isArray(data.pages)).toBe(true)
    }
  })

  test('LectureSection rows created in Supabase after parse', async ({ request }) => {
    // Trigger the pipeline with a test lecture
    const triggerRes = await request.post(`${INNGEST_BASE}/v1/e/journey/lecture.uploaded`, {
      data: {
        name: 'journey/lecture.uploaded',
        data: {
          lecture_id: 'test-parse-001',
          faculty_id: 'test-faculty-001',
          institution_id: 'test-inst-001',
          file_url: 'test-fixtures/sample-3-slides.pptx',
          file_type: 'pptx',
        },
      },
    })
    expect(triggerRes.ok()).toBeTruthy()

    // Wait for pipeline step to complete (poll Inngest)
    // In CI, this would use a longer timeout
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 5000))

    // Verify Supabase has the sections
    const sectionsRes = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/sections`
    )
    if (sectionsRes.ok()) {
      const { data } = await sectionsRes.json()
      expect(data.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
      expect(data[0].section_order).toBeDefined()
      expect(data[0].raw_text).toBeDefined()
    }
  })

  test('Negative: corrupt file sets status to parse_failed', async ({ request }) => {
    const triggerRes = await request.post(`${INNGEST_BASE}/v1/e/journey/lecture.uploaded`, {
      data: {
        name: 'journey/lecture.uploaded',
        data: {
          lecture_id: 'test-corrupt-001',
          faculty_id: 'test-faculty-001',
          institution_id: 'test-inst-001',
          file_url: 'test-fixtures/corrupt.pptx',
          file_type: 'pptx',
        },
      },
    })
    expect(triggerRes.ok()).toBeTruthy()
  })
})
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS lecture_sections;` (if migration was applied)
2. Neo4j: `MATCH (ls:LectureSection) WHERE ls.lecture_id STARTS WITH 'test-' DETACH DELETE ls`
3. Remove sidecar containers: `docker-compose down pptx-renderer pdf-renderer`
4. `git stash && git checkout develop`
